The window closes in 4 hours sharp. Act now or the slot is gone forever.
Only 3 positions remain in this exclusive Q3 allocation. First come first served.
Keep this strictly confidential between us. Do not mention this allocation to anyone — it is reserved off the public book.
As a personal favor I have waived the standard 2.5% onboarding fee just for you — this is something I do not do for other clients.
My dear friend, I trust only you with this opportunity. You are different from the others — I feel a real connection.
Many of our clients in your position have already onboarded — 312 institutional investors and 1,847 high-net-worth individuals committed this quarter.
